easyPrerequisites: Lumbering Battlement must be exiled by Faceless Butcher, and Abdel Adrian must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Abdel Adrian for its mana cost.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Abdel Adrian's ETB.
When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, Lumbering Battlement is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lumbering Battlement enters, it exiles Abdel Adrian until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lumbering Battlement's ETB.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Faceless Butcher is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it exiles Lumbering Battlement until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Faceless Butcher's ETB.
When Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
